description: Portable real-time log viewer: saved views, live filtering, a merged cross-file timeline and a local database of distinct errors.
notes: From LogLens 1.5.4, a Scoop install keeps its workspace and issue database in %APPDATA%\LogLens,
so 'scoop update loglens' keeps your views. 1.5.3 still writes them beside the exe, in this version's folder.
Update with 'scoop update loglens' rather than Help > Check for updates, so Scoop knows which version you have.
